description: This file defines a Python module for interacting with the WhatsApp Cloud API, specifically for handling voice call events such as incoming calls, call acceptance, rejection, and termination. It includes data models for webhook payloads and a client class for API communication.

classes.name: WhatsAppApi
classes.description: Client class for interacting with WhatsApp Cloud API to manage voice calls, including answering, rejecting, and terminating calls.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_token
methods.description: Updates the stored WhatsApp API access token.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_phone_number_id
methods.description: Updates the stored WhatsApp phone number ID.

methods.name: answer_call_to_whatsapp
methods.description: Answers an incoming WhatsApp call, supporting 'pre_accept' and 'accept' actions, sending WebRTC SDP answer.

methods.name: reject_call_to_whatsapp
methods.description: Rejects an incoming WhatsApp call, notifying the caller with a rejection.

methods.name: terminate_call_to_whatsapp
methods.description: Terminates an active WhatsApp call, ending the session.
